title: KPI assimilation sprint notes and decision log
summary: Working doc for Week 3 sprint: consolidate product ops KPIs into a single decision-facing snapshot, surface actionable gaps for upcoming beta, and record go/no-go decisions. This is intentionally terse — use as daily source-of-truth during the prelaunch window.
objectives: Create a 1-page KPI snapshot that non-technical stakeholders can read in 90s
Align gating thresholds for the beta launch (traffic, latency, error rate, infra cost per 1k requests)
Produce a prioritized remediation list with owners and 48/96h SLAs
Capture decision log entries for traffic-phased rollout triggers
kpi_snapshot: API requests/day: 82,300  (target by beta: 120,000; note: projected 14% week-over-week growth)
P95 inference latency (hosted): 210ms  (SLO target: <180ms) — degraded on long-context prompts
Error rate (5xx): 0.72%  (SLO: <0.5%) — spike traced to model pool autoscaler race condition
Avg cost per 1k tokens: $0.45  (target: <$0.38) — primary driver: small-batch overhead and lack of prefix caching
KV cache hit rate (policy-enabled): 22%  (target: 45% for LLM-chat flows)
Beta signups conversion to active keys: 11%  (goal: 18%)
weekly_timeline: Mon: KPI ingestion verified, stub dashboards created. Tue: triage latency/error root causes. Wed: proposal for quick wins (caching/quant profiles). Thu: tabletop scenario for surge + readout to GTM. Fri: decision checkpoint (canary size + phased traffic).
action_items: Diego — implement prefix cache for chat route, measure hit rate increase (due: 2025-01-17, SLA 48h)
Priya — adjust autoscaler cooldown and add a guard for scale-down during hot restarts (due: 2025-01-19)
Maya — prepare concise decision memo for Execs including two rollout options and recommended canary percentage (due: 2025-01-24)
SRE — deploy temporary increased concurrency on dedicated pools for 48h load test (owner: SRE oncall, window: 2025-01-20)
DevRel — prepare beta customer comms with fallback plan describing possible latency anomalies (due: 2025-01-22)
acceptance_criteria: P95 inference latency <= 180ms on synthetic trace representing top 3 prompt shapes
Error rate (5xx) stably < 0.5% over 12-hour rolling window
Cost per 1k tokens reduced by >=10% after batching/cache changes in controlled A/B
At least one week of sustained KV cache hit rate > 35% on chat-heavy traffic
Runbook updated and on-call playbook validated with SRE (acknowledged)
contingency_triggers: If P95 latency > 250ms for more than 2 hours -> abort traffic ramp, revert to smaller model variant and notify GTM
If 5xx > 1.5% -> freeze new beta invites and spin up emergency infra pool
If cost drift > 25% vs projection for 24h -> throttle non-critical batch jobs and enable micro-quantization profile
If KV cache hit rate does not improve by 10ppt after prefix caching experiment -> roll back and schedule deeper profiling study
notes_to_self: Keep decision log brief (timestamp + owner + rationale). Avoid engineering detail in exec memo — focus on impact and mitigations. Follow-up: schedule 30m sync with GTM lead after decision to align messaging windows.
decision_log: 2025-01-16 | Maya Chen | Proceed with small-canary (2%) using model-v1-quant-lite; rationale: cheaper fast fallback while cache rollout completes
2025-01-18 | Diego Alvarez | Postpone broad ramp until autoscaler cooldown fix verified in staging; rationale: observed duplicate scale events causing transient 5xx spikes
2025-01-22 | Priya Nair | Approve dev-rel beta note with explicit performance caveats; rationale: transparency reduces support noise
